text:
nina.pm: Quick thread to finalize a compact private-beta playbook (10 customers) focused on onboarding friction, telemetry fidelity, and safe rollback. Need intake, scoring, and 6-week success gates. Ideas?
omar.eng: keep intake minimal but ask: primary eng contact, expected peak QPS, typical seq length, region, and whether they can run terraform snippet.
kira.design: two lanes: integration (platform teams) and fast-feedback (PMs/product teams). different forms + microcopy for each.
paul.cs: incentive idea: 2 months support credit + 1 performance tuning session. require a signed pilot-handshake: start/end, data opt-in, rollback clause.
devon.sre: telemetry fields to capture: model_variant, seq_len_p50/p95, gpu_util, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size_avg, tail_latency_p99. also tag region.
nina.pm: proposed success gates per customer: setup < 7 business days; steady traffic >=1000 infer/day during stabilization; <3 critical incidents; auto-eval regressions <5%.
omar.eng: onboarding prechecks to automate: VPN/VPC peering, KMS key, sample terraform apply, smoke inference, fluentd/metrics up. Put as a 5-step checklist.
kira.design: embed a 2-question quick survey at day 1 and a longer 8-question pulse at week 3. track completion per lane.
paul.cs: outreach DM copy (short): "Hey <name> — testing private deployments for production workloads. 3mo pilot includes support credit + tuning. Interested? Intake: <link>"
pilot-helper: Intake form created: https://forms.redwood.ai/private-beta-intake (by pilot-helper)
devon.sre: timeline: week0 outreach, week1-2 onboarding, week3-6 stabilization/ops, week7 wrap & readout. Gate at end of week6: >=3 customers meet gates -> scale.
paul.cs: selection rubric fields: business impact (1-5), infra stress (qps/seq lens), automation-readiness (yes/no), security/governance fit, eng availability. weighted scoring to pick final 10.
omar.eng: engineering tasks: onboarding script + infra checks (ETA 7d), telemetry dashboard tiles (ETA 10d), fallback policy with canary toggle (ETA 12d).
kira.design: I'll draft the handshake microcopy and a 5-min onboarding screencast script.
nina.pm: risks: customers starting heavy traffic too soon -> mitigation: agreed ramp + warmup; silent routing failures -> end-to-end smoke + alerting; billing variance -> finance dry-run.
paul.cs: legal will prepare a short addendum and a telemetry opt-in checkbox for the intake form.
nina.pm: action owners: omar (automation), devon (SRE runbook), paul (outreach/legal), kira (content/screencast). reconvene Thurs to review shortlist. Thanks all :rocket:
